Container.Name: zorofin-companion
Container.Overview:
Optional companion for the Zorofin Jellyfin plugin. Adds a Live TV guide with channel logos, live sports from your own channels, request alerts, recommendations, Pick Together (a group swipes on their phones and sees the titles everyone liked) and the Zorofin web look.
Install the Zorofin plugin in Jellyfin first (Dashboard, Plugins, Repositories: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zoraz01/jellyfin-plugin-zorofin/main/manifest.json). Start this container, open its log and copy the bridge secret it prints (also saved in Appdata as bridge-secret). Then in Jellyfin, Dashboard, Plugins, Zorofin, set Companion URL to http://[this server's IP]:9310 and paste the secret into Companion secret. Every module is switched on and set up from that page.
Keep port 9310 on your local network only. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Not affiliated with the Jellyfin project.
Container.Requires: The Zorofin plugin installed in Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Companion port
Config.Description: Jellyfin reaches the companion on this port. Keep it on your local network; don't forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: Bridge secret
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty and the companion creates one on first start, saves it in Appdata as bridge-secret and prints it in the container log. Or set your own (at least 32 characters, e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). The same value goes in the Zorofin plugin's Companion secret.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: How the companion reaches Jellyfin, for example http://SERVER-IP:8096 (your server's IP address).

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key
Config.Description: Optional. A Jellyfin API key (Dashboard, API Keys) for modules that read your library: request alerts, recommendations, Pick Together.

Config.Name: Seerr URL
Config.Description: Optional. How the companion reaches Seerr or Jellyseerr, for example http://[server IP]:5055.

Config.Name: Seerr webhook secret
Config.Description: Optional. At least 32 characters. Turns on request-ready alerts from Seerr's webhook.

Config.Name: Modules
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty and switch modules on from the Zorofin plugin's Companion settings page in Jellyfin.
